name: dsh-ssh-world
description: Make a dsh session's execution world a REMOTE machine over SSH: one plugin registers both ctx.fs (fs-ssh over SFTP-style ssh) and ctx.subprocess (subprocess-ssh: spawn/PTY/exec), sharing one ControlMaster connection. Mount it + disable the local fs/subprocess providers, and the agent's read/write/edit/bash/grep tools operate on that machine's files/processes while the model and memory stay on the hub. Same shape as the E2B integration; target any SSH-reachable host (a fleet machine via -o ProxyJump=<relay>). Zero npm deps (system ssh CLI); dsh-fs / dsh-subprocess are peers provided by the harness.
